affiliations.what: Provider entity to adviser entity keys. A benchmark candidate is affiliated with a fund only when its provider_key maps here to one of the fund's adviser_keys (R2-P0-2, audit round 2 item 2). No string matching: the substring test published false affiliations ('ares' inside 'ishares', 'ark' inside the venture composite). A peer composite has no provider entry: it is the evaluator's own construct and earns at most 1 of 2 on independence by rule, not by affiliation.
